neighbor_and_parent_audit.same_area_partial_coverage: Hawaii area has 14 current descendant locations in two provinces. This issue owns exactly seven of the 13 Hawaii-province locations; the other six are five existing GB ADM2 units and Gardner Pinnacles (separate issue #543). The other province is Midway Islands with its own location, outside this issue. Current region has 15 locations; #543 is in North-Central Pacific.

administrative_completeness_finding.official_boundary: 2024 Census TIGER/Line Honolulu County, GEOID 15003, Honolulu County (StateFP 15, countyFP 003)
administrative_completeness_finding.result: All seven candidate island geometries are wholly contained by TIGER Honolulu County (OGR ST_Contains true; intersection-area ratios 1.0 within floating precision). Current indexed Honolulu ADM2 geometry has bbox [-158.2777,21.2577,-157.6510,21.7127] around Oahu and no intersection with assigned NWHI land. This indicates a detached administrative remainder/source-completeness or role-representation gap; it does not establish that island locations should move or that County geometry should be edited here.
administrative_completeness_finding.follow_up: Regional integrator should coordinate a bounded source-completeness/role review for Honolulu County detached NWHI lands alongside this packet. Request recorded on issues #523 and #339. No inter-region inconsistency demonstrated.

methods_and_uncertainty.physical_method: Pinned v5 candidate report and issue #501 OSM reconstruction report; compare every scoped source polygon and exact source coastline way, checking ring closure, missing nodes, named islet parts, OSM notes, areas, current membership and independent USFWS descriptions. Reefs are distinct from exposed land; ring/way counts are not location quotas.
methods_and_uncertainty.area_method: Upstream #501 report labels areas as source land km2 and uses WGS84 ellipsoidal measurement; values are source calculations, not surveyed shoreline area.
methods_and_uncertainty.administrative_method: Downloaded Census 2024 county archive, verified SHA-256, extracted GEOID 15003, and used GDAL/OGR ST_Contains/intersection-area ratios against all seven candidates. Checked current Honolulu feature extents/intersections.
methods_and_uncertainty.settlement_method: For each raw OSM extract, enumerate every place=island/islet/atoll/archipelago object, all populated-settlement place values, and tagged buildings/man-made/aeroway/tourism features. No city/town/village/hamlet/isolated_dwelling/locality feature and no island population is mapped. Several extracts show field/research/runway/pier/visitor infrastructure; USFWS contextualizes historical or seasonal human use. These data do not prove present occupancy or absence.
uncertainty: USFWS web content is undated and gives rounded land/reef values, not survey-grade contemporary high-tide polygons.
OSM response date is not a shoreline data vintage; NOAA U.S. Vector Shoreline is an object source tag without a release/date.
French Frigate Shoals and Pearl and Hermes emergent-land status changes with sediment, storms, tides and survey epoch; source disagreement remains unresolved.
Laysan hypersaline lagoon ring exists in retained OSM bytes but is absent as a hole in the staged polygon; exact hydrologic boundary/version needs review.
TIGER establishes administrative inclusion, not sovereign ownership or atlas geographic membership.

Two Nihoa coastline ways carry source=Mapbox or NOAA U.S. Vector Shoreline;Mapbox tags. OSM geometry remains ODbL, but the underlying imagery is neither retained nor used as independent primary physical evidence.

Although upstream #501 retains GSHHG 2.3.7 Hawaiʻi/NWHI search-domain records, this packet did not independently associate every older GSHHG component to the seven assigned locations; no exact per-island GSHHG completeness claim is made.

follow_ups.recommendation: Retrieve dated licensed hydrography/shoreline polygon from USFWS/NOAA; decide dry-land water-hole convention and propose a local hole while preserving Laysan ID, outer coast and history.

follow_ups.recommendation: Obtain dated NOAA/USFWS/USGS high-resolution emergent-land inventory/high-tide status; reconcile every OSM component/way and named/unnamed/washed-away islet. Do not create a location per component.

follow_ups.recommendation: Coordinate with #339/regional integration to audit whether the Honolulu ADM2 source omitted detached NWHI lands or intentionally uses a narrower physical role; no shared edit in this packet.
Cross-check authoritative Hawaiian-language/cultural and geographic gazetteer sources for Mokumanamana/Necker name precedence; preserve source names separately from policy label.

locations.name: Laysan
locations.assessment: An independently sourced, closed OSM natural=water/salt=yes/water=lagoon ring (way 170022053; 57 nodes) lies inside the assigned outer coastline, but the accepted location polygon has only one outer ring and no interior water hole. USFWS describes a hypersaline central lake and calls it the only lake in the chain. For a dry-land footprint this is a concrete omitted-water correction: propose subtracting the verified lake boundary while retaining the Laysan identity; exact lake margin/source vintage still needs review.

locations.name: French Frigate Shoals
locations.assessment: USFWS identifies an atoll with a crescent reef, numerous sandy islets, about 0.25 km2 land and 744 km2 reef (undated rounded values). OSM coastline union has eight dry-land components from nine ways and area 0.211878 km2. It includes Tern, East, Gin, Little Gin, Disappearing, Shark, La Perouse Pinnacle and an unnamed way; retained OSM notes explicitly question whether East/Gin/Little Gin/Disappearing remain emergent and whether Shark remains above water. Current high-tide status needs authoritative time-stamped imagery or shoreline products; do not split the shoals into islet locations or assert the 8-part union complete.

locations.name: Necker Island (Hawaii)
locations.assessment: USFWS calls the island Mokumanamana, about 155 miles northwest of Nihoa, a small basalt island about 1/6 km2; it reports worship-site use and no evidence that the small dry island supported resident farming. OSM returns four closed components (one named Mokumanamana, three unnamed) and 0.185836 km2. A single island/islet-group location is suitable, but the displayed Necker name versus the USFWS Hawaiian name warrants a cultural/toponym authority cross-check before any label change; historical use does not imply present habitation.

locations.name: Nihoa
locations.assessment: USFWS describes Nihoa as one rugged basalt island with roughly 900-foot cliffs, about 1 km2, and archaeological remains; the page estimates prehistoric short-stay use rather than permanent residence. OSM reconstruction contains three closed components (one named Nihoa, two unnamed), 0.701013 km2, but the two unnamed way geometries are tagged as traced from Mapbox imagery and have no independent primary shoreline citation in the retained packet. A single named-island location is a defensible candidate, but all three source pieces and complete modern land inventory are insufficiently established; no current settlement is shown.

locations.name: Pearl and Hermes Atoll
locations.assessment: USFWS describes a true, mostly submerged atoll with numerous islets, seven reported above sea level, about 0.36 km2 land, and says emergent islets change. The 2026 OSM-derived union has 13 closed components from 18 coastline ways, 0.417407 km2, with five named components (North, Little North, Seal Kittery, Green/Grass, Bird) and eight unnamed; OSM notes Bird Island changes shape. The count/area mismatch cannot be resolved against an undated USFWS page or inherited NOAA shoreline tag. Preserve one atoll-level location provisionally; request current high-tide/island-status source restoration and component reconciliation before claiming complete membership.

province_assessment.name: Hawaii
province_assessment.other_child_roles: Current siblings include the five gb:USA:ADM2 Hawaii, Honolulu, Kauai, Maui and Kalawao units and Gardner Pinnacles from #543. Thus the child set currently mixes named physical island/atoll locations and administrative county locations. TIGER proves all seven NWHI geometries are in Honolulu County while the current Honolulu ADM2 feature is only Oahu. Regional integration owns combined-parent interpretation under the issue metadata.
province_assessment.finding: Do not infer a coherent homogeneous ADM tier or make shared-parent edits from this partial packet. Resolve source roles and Honolulu County detached members with the other Hawaii packets and regional integrator.
